snippet.title: Zomb Zerro 999 - Official Trailer | VR Survival Horror | Free Demo on Steam
snippet.description:
The secret base is no longer silent.

Official trailer for Zomb Zerro 999, a VR-only psychological horror game where isolation, fear and ritual merge deep inside a mountain.

▶ Wishlist Zomb Zerro 999 on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3303340/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=officialtrailer

▶ Play the free demo now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3673040/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=officialtrailer_demo

You are Sam Keller, a technician sent to investigate a remote mountain facility. But something ancient has awakened.

• Explore the base
• Uncover its secrets
• Survive the supernatural

VR headset required (PC VR / SteamVR).

---
